IMPORTANT
KEEP THIS RIDER WITH YOUR CERTIFICATE
RIDER NATIVE AMERICAN LIMITED COST-SHARING
AMENDS
BLUE CROSS PREMIER PPO GOLD BENEFITS CERTIFICATE
604F
This rider amends the certificate named above to:
• Waive the cost-sharing requirements as described in this rider for Native
American members who qualify for this plan
This rider is deemed in effect when you or your remitting agent is notified.
© 2025 Blue Cross Blue Shield of Michigan
A nonprofit corporation and independent licensee of the Blue Cross and Blue Shield Association

This rider changes the coverage in your certificate. Your rider and certificate
are meant to be read together. It is important to review these changes to
understand how your coverage has changed.
Section 2: What You Must Pay
WHAT’S CHANGING?
This rider waives all annual cost share for medical and prescription drug
services received by Native Americans.
Add the following language to the beginning of
Section 2: What You Must Pay of your certificate:
NOTE: THE LANGUAGE IN BOLD IS NEW TO YOUR CERTIFICATE.
Section 2: What You Must Pay
All in-network and out-of-network cost-sharing requirements for all
medical and prescription drug services received by Native Americans who
qualify for this plan will be waived when those services are obtained
through:
• Indian Health Services facilities;
• Contract Health Services providers;
• Providers who are referred by Contract Health Services providers; or
• Indian Health Services pharmacies.
If medical and prescription drug services are obtained through
any facility or provider not mentioned above, then all of the
in-network and out-of-network cost-sharing requirements will
apply to those services.
This includes your cost share for any covered specialty drugs,
including those obtained outside our exclusive pharmacy
network for specialty drugs.
You have PPO coverage under this certificate. PPO coverage uses a “Preferred
Provider Organization” provider network. What you must pay depends on the
type of provider you choose. If you choose an “in-network” provider, you most
often pay less money than if you choose an “out-of-network” provider.
2 © 2025 Blue Cross Blue Shield of Michigan

GENERAL
Until further notice, all the provisions in your certificate and in your related
riders are unchanged and in full force and effect, except as stated in this rider.
